prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sprite sheet called The After-School Static. Original image inputs guide complete footless continuous charcoal-plum splat silhouettes, tiny goo hands, thick sculpted filled eyelids, ivory sclera, distinct red iris and black pupil. The fictional Teenager are conveyed through relative body proportions, facial attitude and props. All are soft organic ink blobs with simple age-appropriate clothing accents. No actual humans. Six independent full characters in a strict 3-column by 2-row landscape sheet, 1536×1024 PNG with real transparent alpha. Equal substantial scale within this sheet. Keep silhouettes and all props within generous clear alpha gutters and canvas margins. No background scene, shadow disc, frame, text, logo or branding. Smooth softly satin handmade plasticine with sparse larger modeled marks, broad fabric folds, smooth glass and finished plastic. No grit or crust. Teeth behind lips. No inherited reference wings, eyepatches or costumes. Washed charcoal hoodie, brick red, muted lilac, moss and denim blue. Ordinary layered clothing and short fitted accessories.
Row-major cast:
1. Male-read dryly amused hoodie wearer. tall folded comma blob, half-lidded side-eye and tiny crooked grin. Key cue: small handheld audio player and one loop of cable.
2. Female-read intense sketchbook maker. tall lean pear, focused downturned eyes and firm lips. Key cue: small black sketchbook with a simple blank stitched patch and pencil.
3. Male-read nervous skater. broad crooked blob, raised eyebrows and embarrassed smile. Key cue: short rounded skateboard carried upright with small wheels, intact goo base visible.
4. Male-read distracted music fan. round uneven blob, looking away and closed absent smile. Key cue: one pair of headphones held close at neck.
5. Female-read skeptical style experimenter. upright reverse curl, sharply skeptical side-eye and pursed mouth. Key cue: small smooth pocket mirror and one colorful hair clip on a goo lobe.
6. Male-read quiet after-school commuter. squat long blob, weary gaze and nearly flat mouth. Key cue: little backpack with a wide zipper pull held at chest.
All six whole ink blobs are distinct and easy to isolate. Simple readable surreal props and varied expressions.
